headline: Prime-angle SE swell at chest high, just short-period and cross-on — dawn patrol or bust.
today: The angle is dialed for Lido and there's size to 3.5ft, but the 4-6s period keeps it soft and the WSW wind is cross-on and climbing after dawn. Best shot is the first light session before that 10mph morning bump ruins the texture. Fish or groveler, and don't expect much shape on the sets.

daysToWatch.note: Drops to 2ft but 6s period and N offshore into the afternoon — clean and fun on a log. Best window of the week here.
Building toward 3ft on a good angle with light morning winds. Short period but glassy early, worth targeting.
